operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: gate 2's open cases (tests/flow/porous_handover_cases.py): the open vessel two diameters long at D/h 16 with a fixed inflow (vessel), between a given pressure and a resistance (vessel, laws pressure and windkessel), a coaxial plug of half the lumen's radius with a fixed inflow (vessel, radius 0.25), the twin rig at D/h 8 or 12 (occluded_twin); steady Stokes, two steps, the default tolerance and cap; the line moved with line_at; the leak's arms the pressure-driven vessel at D/h 8 and 16, a plug half a diameter long at mid-length, resolved (the line moved to 1e-4), sqrt(K)/h 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.12
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: 50 draws a case (forced_draw 0 to 49; the twin rig's quiet_draw 0 to 49)

gate_line_0p01.claim: with the 0.1h interior and the line at sqrt(K)/h 0.01, the held solve converges at every step of every draw in each of the four open cases
gate_line_0p01.case: probe/line.py <case> 0.01 0.1h, cases inflow, pressure, gap, twin

prediction.value: 50/50 converged and finite in each case
prediction.basis: measured-before (one twin draw at about this K) and inference (an eleventh of the stiffness at 0.003, where the forced and gap cases converged)
prediction.why: the twin rig's worst draw converged at ten times the 0.003 line's K, and the 0.01h interior's line converged in every box measured

gate_line_0p01.metric: per draw: the run's sum of the solve report's at-cap, stagnated and not-finite counts zero, the velocity finite
gate_line_0p01.if_wrong: a draw that stops: reported with its case, draw and stop; the line then 0.03 if that converges
gate_line_0p01.cannot_discriminate_if: every draw converges in zero or one iteration (the solve not run)

gate_line_0p03.claim: with the 0.1h interior and the line at sqrt(K)/h 0.03, the held solve converges at every step of every draw in each of the four open cases
gate_line_0p03.case: probe/line.py <case> 0.03 0.1h, cases inflow, pressure, gap, twin

prediction.value: 50/50 converged and finite in each case
prediction.why: a hundredth of the stiffness at 0.003; #264's gates converged there in periodic tubes

gate_line_0p03.if_wrong: neither 0.01 nor 0.03 converging on every draw: the open vessel's sub-line route at 0.1h refused by name, routed to the 0.01h interior

gate_line_0p01h.claim: with the 0.01h interior at its line (0.01), the forced and gap cases converge on every draw, as the pressure-driven vessel and the twin rig did (runs 43207166164, 43201390806)

prediction.value: 50/50 converged and finite in each case
prediction.basis: measured-before (the other two open cases at this line)
prediction.why: the 0.01h interior's line converged in every box measured

gate_line_0p01h.if_wrong: reported with its case and draws; the open box's 0.01h line then measured higher

gate_leak.claim: the open vessel's leak (the intercept of its conductance, the throughflow over the face drop, against K F_B(K)) is at most 1 % of the throughflow at the 0.1h line chosen, at D/h 8 and 16

prediction.value: the intercept within 5e-3 of the conductance at sqrt(K)/h 0.01 (and so of a larger one at 0.03), each D/h, by the fit with the root term; the fit's relative residuals under 2e-3
prediction.basis: measured-before (the laptop smoke at D/h 8; the periodic tube's floor) and inference (D/h 16 the same band)
prediction.why: the periodic floor was under 1e-4 of the throughflow at 0.003 (D/h 16), and a higher line's throughflow is larger

gate_leak.metric: the intercept c of G = Q / dp_faces = a K F_B + b K F_B sqrt(K)/h + c over the five points, each weighted by 1 / G, over G at the line; the fit's largest relative residual beside it; the linear fit (no root term), first written, reported too
gate_leak.if_wrong: an intercept over 1 % at 0.01: the line moved to the least measured row where it is under 1 %
gate_leak.cannot_discriminate_if: the fit's largest relative residual over 1e-2 (the intercept not resolved at the rule's line)

gate_line_0p03.measured: converged at every step and finite on 50 of 50 draws in each case; iterations at most 995 / 998 / 136 / 2504
